scripts.contracts:generate: bash scripts/contracts/generate-public.sh && bash scripts/contracts/generate-scoring.sh && bash scripts/contracts/generate-terms-public.sh && bash scripts/contracts/generate-terms-internal.sh
scripts.terms:build: npm run build --workspace @finance2/terms-api && npm run build --workspace @finance2/terms-web
scripts.terms:lint: npm run lint --workspace @finance2/terms-api && npm run lint --workspace @finance2/terms-web
scripts.terms:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @finance2/terms-api && npm exec --workspace @finance2/terms-web -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.terms:test: npm run test --workspace @finance2/terms-api && npm run test --workspace @finance2/terms-web
